scope: Vanta initial Scaled order product rule: explicit 2–5 child GTC LIMIT plan, preview, confirmation, sequential current-EOA fresh checks and submission/query, no automatic continuation or compensation.
product_rule_confirmation: Initial rule was proposed and disclosed; explicit product confirmation is still pending. Do not claim these options are verified Aster App behavior.

domain.coverage: Exact endpoints, distinct ticks, all counts and buy/sell; low-price quantity remainder; offset LOT minimum and price origin; sub-wei-like precision conservation; filters, funds/capabilities, immutable and tampered plans.

controller.coverage: Explicit fresh scoped preparation, unique frozen IDs, per-child fresh funds and sequential exact requests, shared locks, pending journal, no replay, pre/post-send stop, expiry/refusal/drift, same-time account events, wallet isolation and GET-only unknown recovery.

signed_repository_and_host_file.coverage: Both directions × one-way/hedge × all-known/second-unknown. Exact signed/transmitted POST bytes, user=signer=current EOA, ordinary LIMIT/GTC shape, real journal file verified before each POST, completed records removed, restart recovers only the sent unresolved second child and never sends the third.

widgets.coverage: Bilingual 320-wide/text1.5/landscape; complete preview/IDs/percentage/notional and confirmation, cancel/refusal input retention, unknown edit lock and GET only, wallet form reset, ordinary-only entry, route exit and five-order sell stop button.

acceptance_evidence.full_regression: All 1733 existing and new tests pass.

native_testing: Not performed at user request; no device tools or APK installation. Real wallet signing/return, Aster permission/execution, native layout/storage and process-kill recovery remain pending; see ../native-verification-pending.md.
ios: Linux lacks macOS/Xcode; not built or tested.
boundaries: No extra wallet or agent is created; same-EOA Aster authorization remains unproven.
Independent sequential orders may partly succeed; stopping does not cancel already sent orders.
GET-only unknown recovery never resubmits an ID or resumes an unsent plan.
Margin reference is gross limit notional/leverage, before netting and excluding fees, pending orders and released margin.
Enable-trading, full subaccounts, actual funding/transfers, complete Portfolio, Chase and ordinary/dedicated-close BBO remain incomplete; BAPI statistics/TWAP skipped by user decision.
build_notes: Android release succeeds with existing third-party Kotlin migration/compatibility notices. Not installed.
